This work product is populated based on discussions with the client considering the impact of the gap and its underlying root cause. When working with the client to identify gaps between the current and future states, each gap identified can be listed, along with a summary to provide higher level results to the key stakeholders.

Examples of the types of gaps include strategic, operational, financial or/and compliance related.

When populating this work product, consider the following:

  • Provide a detailed description of the gap that needs to be addressed
  • Determine the related functional area (e.g., finance, HR, IT etc.) impacted by the gap
  • Determine the type of impact the gap has on the organization (e.g., strategic, operational, compliance)
  • Analyze and describe the root cause of the gap (where applicable)
  • Identify the priority the client places on addressing each gap and explore the options to address the prioritized gaps

To identify the gaps between the current and future state, document the impact of each gap, as well as communicate the findings with key stakeholders. The gap analysis will serve as a baseline for identifying improvement opportunities to close the gaps between current and future state.
